- **Why p3:** a long api-name chip squeezes the item title below objectui#12611's 200 px floor. The title stays readable on hover.
- **For the claimant:** The filer's `domain:ui` and `area:studio` stand. The chips truncate before the title does.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 3 on 「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到3」, this session's chat, 2026-10-16)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: two Tailwind class tokens and one header's title row inside `@object-ui/app-shell`; `studio-tokens.ts` and `StudioItemHeader` are not on the package entry (read at dispatch); no exported type, prop or `@object-ui/i18n` key moves.
Responsibility: n/a — a Studio item's title cut to a few characters by a long api name
Thread-read: 6226332743
Serial constraints cleared: no open objectui PR touches `StudioItemHeader.tsx` or `studio-tokens.ts`, and no `pm:dispatched` objectui claim names them (read at dispatch). `STUDIO_ITEM_TITLE` and `STUDIO_API_CHIP` have no reader outside `StudioItemHeader.tsx`.
